what: For harness/v2/pure_scripts.py (docs/v2/plan/lanes/pure-scripts/design.md section 8; docs/v2/plan/lanes/pure-scripts/measure.md): the build report has to say, per build script run, whether its script was proved pure and the first impurity otherwise. (1) crates/blaze-api/src/lib.rs: add to `BuildScriptRan` a field `purity: ScriptPurity` with `pub enum ScriptPurity { Unproved, Impure { said: String }, Pure { identity: ContentId, hit: bool } }` (Unproved: no proof was made, e.g. BLAZE_SANDBOX=off; Impure.said: `hir_ty_pure::Impure::said()`; Pure.identity: `hir_ty_pure::Proof::identity`; hit: the value came from the store under its pure key, so the script was neither built nor run), and its Ref form for BuildScriptRanRef. (2) crates/blaze-ui/src/api.rs: `script_json(ran: BuildScriptRanRef) -> String`, one line `{"reason": "blaze-script", "package_id": ..., "out_dir": ..., "purity": "unproved"|"impure"|"pure", "said": str|null, "identity": hex|null, "hit": bool}`, printed under --message-format=json right after each `build-script-executed` line wherever `work_json`'s `blaze-work` line is printed (crates/blaze-cargo/src/cli/print: route to lane cargo if it is theirs). cargo's own `build-script-executed` stays byte for byte cargo's. The filling side (setting the field in blaze-cargo's script glue) is requested of lane pure-scripts separately.
